atoms.title: Access control models (RBAC, DAC, MAC)
atoms.objective: Explain what access control is, distinguish between the three primary access control models (DAC, MAC, RBAC), and select the appropriate model for a given organizational scenario.

atoms.title: Roles, permissions, and least privilege
atoms.objective: Explain how permissions are bundled into roles, apply the principle of least privilege to evaluate whether a role assignment is over-permissioned, and identify the risks of privilege creep and excessive standing access.
